content.label: I’m a long time user. The app had a recent rewrite and a few bugs as you’d expect. But it’s come back better and faster now. Loving it.
I persevered but the bugs and loss of functionality have driven me back to Apple podcast player

When you say you fixed an issue with continuous play, did you even test it? It just hangs and stops playing. it’s not fixed. 

Since July 2024 this app has really gone back into beta. Podcasts are alll over the place and randomly stop playing. The UX now makes no sense at all. From all the 1 star reviews you’ve received since then, just roll back and leave it. There was nothing wrong prior to July. Write something else if you’re bored.
Used to be the best app on the platform. The big update ruined so many features, it’s very clunky and feels like the original dev gave the job to his kid for their first project.

Since a recent update, many basic functionalities are missing or bugged. Podcasts do not download reliably, making it hard to prepare a few before I go out. Streaming is unreliable, pausing playback seemingly at random, no matter how much has been downloaded. Things that used to be automatic and simple, now need constant attention and managing. 

This is especially upsetting as this has been a reliable and well designed app for years. Fingers crossed the updates can return it to that level of quality.

Moved to Overcast nearly a year after multiple errors with the Apple Podcast app. Just moved back after the recent update made the app unusable. Can’t stream, only download option plus multiple errors when pressing all episodes button that just displayed a single podcast.
Used to be able to specify which episode to play next. Now it is no longer available. Rather stupid “improvement”.
This used to be my favourite podcast app. I gave it five stars. The app no longer does what I need it to do. Hubris.

Overcast is a fantastic app and I’m loving the new update! I particularly love the attention to detail on small playback features such as jumping back a tiny bit when you resume after pausing, and the ability to undo a big time seek if you accidentally bump the lock screen.
Way better than the Apple Podcasts app. Easy to use, and syncs to my Apple Watch flawlessly. I use this app every day.

title.label: Formerly the GOAT, now a buggy mess

content.label: I know apps can’t stay the same forever, but surely the idea of “upgrading” means improving? I’ve used Overcast for years but am transition to Apple Podcasts because this latest version of Overcast is a mess. Despite streaming being removed and now apparently put back in, the next episode in any list won’t play unless the phone is unlocked and the app is in the foreground. A bit of a pain while driving a car! I hope it improves. Maybe I’ll try back in a few months.

Frequent updates have resolved a lot of the most impactful issues the redesign brought. Would love to be able to queue a podcast to play immediately after the current one finishes, but have not figured out how to do this with queues in the app.
Easy to use and thoughtful design with some advanced features not found in other podcast players.
Took a bit to get used to the new look but it’s all there :)
Without question the best podcast app out there. Without. Question.
Stupid app does not even loop back to top of list when last one is finished.

title.label: Pressing pause on Overcast for now

content.label: Overcast has been my podcast partner through countless hours of travel, commuting, sitting, standing, doing lots or doing nothing much at all. And while I understand renewal needs to happen with all apps, the latest version is just too broken to justify its continued use. First streaming support went, now it's back, but I'll be darned if I can get it working, unless the phone is unlocked and Overcast is the active app on screen. Any podcast app that needs to be interacted with WHILE DRIVING is a bad app. Transferring all my subscriptions and playlists over to Apple Podcasts.

title.label: Streaming is back! And sleep, etc. Great update.

content.label:
Overcast has always been the most thoughtfully designed and engineered podcast app, the best kind of indie software by someone devoted to the craft.

The developer (Marco) recently completed a full rewrite of the underpinnings to use Apple’s latest frameworks. This made it faster, but in the process we briefly lost a couple of key features.
Chief among these for me was streaming, which I use for fast start under Australia’s unreliable network conditions. Downloads might stall overnight on Wifi because it rains and the NBN is still half copper junk, but I could always get on my bike and into the 5G wonderland, hit Go and start streaming nonsense into my ears. 

Reliable fast start made the experience work for me, and when I lost it I even toyed with switching to the built-in podcast app… but the sight of Kyle and Jackie O, Australia’s most banal ragebait radio hosts being promoted in a giant glowing square led me to delete it and wash my eyeballs. I still feel a little ill. 

The upside is I stuck with Overcast, and when Marco saw the sadness coming through the reviews he immediately announced that he would do something about it, and within what, weeks? I don’t know how time works any more. Anyway, very quickly the app was updated with fast-start streaming again and my life is complete.

Oh and the sleep feature, people use that and were sad. I think it didn’t go away, but it became less easy to trigger and moved to a spot where people couldn’t find it. Marco has announced that he’s moving it back to one-tap availability, so never fear, my somnolent friends.

title.label: Was a fan until the last updates

content.label: App is now unusable for me stuck on a syncing screen for the last two days

Recent versions have definitely gotten faster 👍 But it’s worse for being able to move several episodes up or down my queue. It’s slower to delete a bunch of played episodes from the queue. It’s harder to download the next N episodes in the queue. Because the list of playlists is horizontal, it’s harder to see if there are new episodes in smart playlists. I’d like to move the list of podcasts to another screen and devote the home screen to playlists.

There used to be a link to the webpage for the episode?
The updated app is really really really good!
Thank you, Marco!

Only time will tell if I prefer the new UI choices, and I have discovered since the update that I used and enjoyed streaming quite a lot. Despite these changes, this is still hands-down the best podcast app I have ever used and I would be lost without it. Another five-star update, warts and all.

I've been using this app for YEARS but I'm about to start looking for an alternative for all the reasons that others have given. In particular, not being able to stream while playing is a killer. To avoid the incredible inconvenience of having to download before playing I've set it to automatic downloads - and as a result am using more storage than all other apps on my iPad - right now it's using 20% of the whole system. That's not sustainable but the days of waiting around for a download are well past. If only I could roll back to the previous version. I'll keep returning for a while to see if there are any improvements but I'm not hopeful. What a shame.

Much of the functionality, convenience and enjoyability has been lost in this recent update. I hate leaving negative reviews but I’m really disappointed with the changes for easily my favourite app and I’ll be looking for alternatives.

title.label: Was great, but a re-write introduced lots of bugs

content.label:
I chose Overcast over pocketcast and others a few years ago, as it let me exert fine control over the rules of what went into my playlist.  I have a playlist for my morning routine, another for long runs, another for home chores, etc. Each is a refined mix of specific podcasts, orders, lead-in/lead-out ads clipped off, and so on.

Unfortunately, the rewrite has caused quite a few hiccups. Playlists have gone from a nice wide row that you can hit easily while running or wearing motorbike gloves, to a small button that’s more fiddly, and that scrolls horizontally and not vertically. Podcasts won’t download on-demand on mobile data when tapped any more - it hangs. Playing progress of minutes and sometimes whole podcasts is lost. The Carplay screen lags behind what’s on the phone - sometimes showing a different podcast!

Overcast used to be a great app, but it does have a lot of bugs to fix. Hopefully they’ll get resolved soon.

I switched to overcast a few years ago after trying a few options. I’ve stuck with this one for several years ago.
With the recent upgrade I’ve taken the time to subscribe and support the developer.

title.label: Radical UI changes should be prototyped

content.label:
It was a great app. 

Requires downloads only so now have to think in advance before using it when driving. 

Major UI changes require multiple taps instead of using swipes. When having to do taps it is too easy to inadvertently launch a different podcast episode. 

Also lost “Play Next” option. I now have to think a lot more about what podcast episodes I play. I don’t want that burden. 

Classic example of changing too many things at once and not working through prototypes with testers. 

UX design is about workflow not just appearance and Marco unfortunately seems to be arrogant about these failures, based on listening to him on podcasts.

title.label: Way better than apple’s podcast app

content.label: Lots of flexibility. Made the switch a couple weeks of year’s ago , no regrets.
New update= terrible. In particular the download before streaming thing is very frustrating. A real shame- I really liked this app.

I’ve been using Overcast for many years but sadly the latest update has made playing my my podcasts more complex than it should be.  

The missing "Play Next" option is only one of a number of features broken by the recent update. 

The author is working on it so I hope that further updates will be tested properly and address the issues the app currently has.

 I’ll keep using it for now but will also be evaluating other apps - something I’ve not done for a long time.

Was the best podcast app forever but the latest month has killed it for me, not being able to just stream is a huge deal for my use case and the dev has laid out clearly why he removed it But I’ve had endless issues with downloading podcasts, not just press and play now the download will kill itself towards the end or say I don’t have internet etc etc Still 5 stars for the hundreds of hours it saved me and how much I treasured it before the latest update, wish him all the best
Love the new design, keep up the good work!
This is still my favourite podcast app for its ease of use. I’m loving the new updates. Keep up the great work!
I have used Overcast for about 5 years now. I think it brilliant. The new format makes it even better

I use this app every day and I love it. It is my daily companion for podcast pleasure. 

It is a pro app for listening to podcasts. Elegant, powerful, unobtrusive. Smart speed is fantastic. A benchmark for excellence in app development. Ads? I'm all in on premium, so no problem there. But I don't think it's a big deal either way. Great work Marco.
I like the update. I don’t mind the streaming going away. Works for me when I’m often in a bad network coverage in a  multistory car park
Yes there's been a few issues, but they've been fixed and it works great. Love the UI updates!

The Overcast major update and redesign is clearly a work-in-progress that I’m hopeful will get to great places; but it’s not there yet. 

Currently my biggest gripe is that there is no good and clear indicator of a new unplayed episode being present in a podcast feed. 
I think there is a coloured text distinction, but the difference is black vs. dark grey.

Anyway, still needs work but still a great podcast app.

title.label: Great app, but update ruined one obscure feature

content.label:
Love the app, and all the functions. I love being able to auto skip the ads for the first 15 seconds and last 30 seconds of a podcast. However in the last update I lost one feature that I rely on to sleep. I don’t know how niche this is. 

I’ve found that listening to old podcasts is a great way to drift off to sleep. I don’t have to worry about missing things, because I’ve heard it before, and it helps me focus instead of my mind whirling on a billion different topics as I am trying to sleep. When one podcast ends, I used to be able to just press play on my headphones to start the next one. Since the last major update, it will not. I now have to get my phone out and manually start the next one. I like listening to lots of shorter podcasts, so I’m doing this every 10 minutes and it just kills it. Sometimes I wake up in the middle of the night, and I used to be able to just start another short podcast without even opening my eyes, but now I need to roll over, look at a screen and start the next one. I can find a setting to automatically play the next one, but then it just plays through the whole playlist without ever stopping. I’ve tried using all sorts of different playlists and options, and I just can’t get it to play the next podcast when I press play on my headphones.

title.label: The best podcast app there is

content.label: Overcast has remained my go to podcast player app for a decade because it’s developer sweats the small stuff and doesn’t accept mediocrity. The recent redesign came as a surprise but it’s very clean, more responsive and overall a net improvement over the previous. Bravo ❤️
Sadly it’s no longer useable due to the constant progress loss.
I’ll hold judgement

title.label: Smart Speed has saved me 268 hours

content.label: 10/10 Audio engine; the best in the game. 4/5 for the new design. Use Marco’s app; it is good and he is good!

It’s extremely buggy and removed a lot of useful features. Controls are no more “reachable” than the old, just worse. It no longer streams either. Because the episode limit feature is broken, I ate through the entirety my iPhones storage (offloading apps I needed offline) and an *annual* data allowance downloading all my curated podcasts before I even noticed anything was wrong.
Way harder to find chapters - requires very precise tapping instead of being just there. Navigation less intuitive (again lots of precise touch targets). Hoping this improves again.

title.label: Long time user, love the direction of the new design

content.label: Would love to the see the sleep timer back in it’s usually place, however I love the new refreshed look of the app. I never used playlists in the past but I have now discovered them and are my preferred way of listening to podcasts 🙏

Nothing comes close to overcasts smart speed/voice boost. I’ve tried other apps to dabble in their podcast management options, but always seem to come back to overcast. This most recent update has worked wonders at making the areas I care about snappier, and I’m excited to see what comes next.

title.label: Rushed update from an arrogant developer

content.label: I Import/Export has been removed and not just buried in the new design. I also assume this is not malicious, but part of the rush job to meet the arbitrary deadline of the 10-year anniversary. Lack of Import/Export is just incredible. A huge design change and a bunch of new bugs and I can’t even switch (temporarily or not) to another player. I wouldn’t have been using Overcast since v1 if it hadn’t had Import/Export. I give a one-star review because the developer has been obnoxiously arrogant about this release. No one else cared about the 10-year anniversary, but the user base has been subject to a massive design and functionality change. The developer doesn’t use unit tests and this release did not get the full TestFlight beta that it desperately needed. Now that negative feedback is coming in, the developer is complaining about being held “hostage” to the users. Just incredible.

title.label: Much better than the Apple app

content.label: Have been a long time user of the Overcast app after issues with the Apple app. Really enjoy using, the updated app looks good although a few of the settings changed from the previous iteration and I had to did through the settings to see what changed.
